hosted_trial_summary: 2-week hosted API trial (Jan 15-Feb 5). Observed steady-state 9 QPS average with bursts to 110 QPS during product marketing promotions. Median request: 280 tokens prompt + 320 tokens completion. Errors rare (<0.3%). Cost sensitivity high: product team projects 1M monthly active queries by Q4 and wants predictable unit costs.
dedicated_capacity_recommendation: Initial recommendation: 2 Dedicated GPU nodes with autoscale buffer (equivalent to 4x A100-80GB pooled or 2x H100 depending on availability). Basis: target sustained 40 QPS with capacity to absorb 120 QPS bursts via burst/autoscale. Include KV cache for doc-search to reduce repeat token volume by estimated 35%. Suggest quantization plan for background reranking (use 8-bit quantized model instances).
traffic_forecast: Projected baseline QPS (Q2 start): 12 QPS avg -> 40 QPS sustained within 3 months
Peak burst forecast (marketing/event): 110-150 QPS for 10-20 minutes, expected 3-4 times/month
Concurrency target (chat sessions): 18 concurrent generation contexts typical, 35 concurrency for promotions
Token mix: 60% short prompts (<150 tokens) for embeddings/rerank, 30% medium (150-500 tokens) chat, 10% long (>500 tokens) summaries
Monthly tokens projection: 18M prompts + 35M completions (~53M tokens/mo) at scale scenario
pricing_feedback: Finance requested three pricing scenarios: conservative (2-node Dedicated), aggressive (4-node reserved), and hybrid (hosted baseline + dedicated reserved for steady-state). Asked for clear per-token and per-hour numbers, and break-even horizon (months) vs hosted.
sales_pitch_snippets: Focus on predictable unit economics: show 6-12 month break-even vs hosted at 50M tokens/mo.
Highlight smart routing: host small requests on hosted to absorb spikes while dedicated handles steady queries.
Promise: built-in fallbacks + audit logs to satisfy security team (SAML + KMS integration).
